_readme: The only file you edit. Everything else is measured from Shopify.
AFTER YOU PLACE A PO, update that SKU's last_po block: date + units.
That is the whole maintenance burden. The script counts units sold since
that date to work out what is left, because Shopify inventory is untracked
on this store and reads negative store-wide (Camille Navy at -1005).
lead_time_days     = sold out -> in hand, from the agent (Brooks, 2026-08-08).
safety_pct         = extra cover on top of lead-time demand. 0.25 = 25%.
baseline_stall_pct = the SKU's HEALTHY share of labels aged 5-10 days that
still have no carrier scan. Measured Apr-Aug 2026.
When the live figure runs well above this, the agent is
issuing tracking numbers for parcels that do not exist,
which is the earliest visible sign he has run dry. The
